title: Japanese Okonomiyaki Pancake
description: A popular Japanese savory pancake made with batter, cabbage, and various toppings.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cabbage and batter mix.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil to the bowl and mix well.
If using shrimp or bamboo shoots, add them to the bowl and mix.
Heat a non-stick pan or okonomiyaki pan over medium heat.
Add 1/4 cup of the cabbage-batter mixture to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Loosen the pancake with a spatula and flip it over. Cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Repeat with the remaining mixture, forming 4-6 pancakes.
Serve hot with green onion and your favorite toppings.
